observations.text: The speaker claims to be a skilled programmer but expresses frustration that their technical abilities are not valued by others.
observations.quote: I can fucking debug your database constraints like a motherfucker, like seriously. By hand, look at this shit, look at this shit.

observations.text: The speaker uses 'I'm more old man' to describe their perceived age or maturity level in relation to younger people.
observations.quote: I'm more old man. I think I'm more old man.

observations.text: The speaker acknowledges their tendency to create things out of emotional need but feels ashamed about it.
observations.quote: I don't want to think hard about it. But there's a reason you're sitting here by yourself, homeboy.

observations.text: The speaker uses 'don't kill yourself' as a mantra for difficult days.
